tasks.short: Counsel patients and families on hearing communication

steps.what: Hear the actual patients' and families' communication difficulties, hearing-loss context and goals before choosing instruction.
Find the current approved hearing and communication technique materials in {DOCS} for the actual needs identified in s1.
Counsel and instruct patients and their families in techniques to improve hearing and communication related to hearing loss, adapting practice to actual understanding and response.
outputs: Actual instruction, practice and observed understanding

steps.what: Write and check the actual counselling content, patient response and agreed communication goals in the clinical-record draft {OTHER}.
inputs: Actual instruction and response from s3

steps.what: Save the exact checked counselling note in the clinical record {OTHER}.

tasks.design: Configure source tags and native search in {DOCS} for approved communication exercises. The audiologist selects suitable instruction, coaches the family and writes the actual clinical note in {OTHER}; no ambient transcript or generated treatment advice is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant approved materials can be scattered across folders.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding a family's communication habits and adapting instruction.
tasks.human_edge: Listening, demonstration and checking real understanding.

ambition.what: No additional clinical service is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Clinical decisions and patient time remain with the audiologist.

reach.learn: Scope boundaries and accessible communication practice

evidence.claim: Native document tags and filters can shorten retrieval of approved teaching material without replacing counselling.

assumptions: Boundary is actual counselling and its existing clinical record. Shares are conditional E1 workflow estimates, not measured baselines.

The audiologist produces actual goals in s1 and actual instruction and response in s3. Existing content owners supply approved material identifier, topic, audience, language and version in {DOCS}; missing tags require manual source reading counted in s2.

Test native search first. No saving is claimed for existing runtime, patient dialogue, substantive note writing or same-system save. The ordinary completed-note check supplies the requested save gate without an extra approval stage; edits invalidate it.
research_questions: Does a native topic and language view reduce retrieval effort while keeping obsolete exercises out?

already_counted.description: Actual needs, residual lookup, counselling, note and save remain counted.

approvals.approved_version: Exact actual counselling note checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 8 x 25% retrieval reduction = 2 gross points less 0.5 upkeep. Already indexed materials yield no benefit; no counselling or record-tail saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Participate in professional hearing and balance learning

steps.what: Review the actual conference or training agenda and source material in {DOCS} against hearing or balance knowledge gaps.
inputs: Actual agenda and provided source material

steps.what: Participate in conferences or training to update or share knowledge of new hearing or balance disorder treatment methods or technologies, testing claims through discussion.
Write and check actual learning points and completed participation in the existing professional-development record {OTHER} after attending.
inputs: Actual participation and learning from s2

steps.what: Save the checked actual participation entry in the professional-development record {OTHER}.

tasks.design: Keep actual professional participation and critical reading human. Inspect native agenda views in {DOCS} and record fields in the professional-development system {OTHER}; neither changes the substantive reading, learning reflection or near-zero save in this workflow.
tasks.previous_blocker: The value is actual learning and professional exchange, rather than document transport.
tasks.enabler_now: No additional automation is justified for this particular participation cycle.
tasks.still_hard: Evaluating new treatment claims and sharing practice responsibly.

ambition.what: No additional learning outcome is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in clinical authority or participation.

reach.learn: Distinguish product claims from clinically applicable evidence

evidence.claim: Professional participation and reflective learning remain human even with digital agendas and development records.

assumptions: Boundary is the actual learning activity and an existing brief development entry, not a newly invented conference report. Shares are E1 estimates of this conditional cycle.

Event organisers provide agenda, session titles and source material. The audiologist selects sessions in s1 and produces actual participation and learning in s2; missing evidence is obtained manually, never inferred from a calendar end time.

Native agenda filtering is tested but actual source appraisal remains. The short record has new reflective content, not repeated form-filling. There is no duplicate registration, approval packet or certificate submission assumed in the baseline.

Zero follows separate source reading, participation, record writing and save. No ongoing change is introduced so incremental upkeep is zero. The ordinary completed-entry check is the requested gate; no extra self-approval time and edits invalidate it.
research_questions: Is there a real repeated transfer or registration burden beyond this learning task that should be measured separately?

already_counted.description: Actual reading, participation, record writing and save all remain counted.

incremental.description: No new workflow or tool to maintain.

approvals.approved_version: Exact actual learning entry checked in s3

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Actual learning, discussion and brief substantive reflection remain after checking native agenda and record options; no measured repeated entry is assumed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Establish actual patients' communication needs, hearing assessment findings, practical constraints and experience of devices through assessment and discussion.
Find actual assistive-device specifications and availability in the existing clinical device catalogue {OTHER} for the needs and impairments established in s1.
inputs: Actual needs and constraints from s1

steps.what: Recommend assistive devices according to patients' needs or nature of impairments, discussing suitability and checking actual practical use where applicable.
Write and check the actual device recommendation, rationale, limitations and patient response in the clinical-record draft {OTHER}.
Save the exact checked recommendation note in the clinical record {OTHER}.

tasks.design: Configure native catalogue filters for published specifications and compatibility in the clinical device catalogue {OTHER}. The audiologist checks the source options, makes the recommendation with the patient and records the actual rationale in {OTHER}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Device specifications are searched across unfiltered catalogue pages.
tasks.enabler_now: Native catalogue filters and current specification views.
tasks.still_hard: Real-world usability, impairment context and patient preference.
tasks.human_edge: Clinical judgment and observing practical device use.

ambition.what: No automated device-selection service is assumed.

tasks.altitude: The audiologist retains device suitability decisions.

reach.task: Discuss assistive devices in daily activities

evidence.claim: Catalogue filters can retrieve published device specifications without deciding clinical suitability.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual needs, source lookup, recommendation and its existing clinical record. Device ordering, fitting and prescribing are distinct actions and receive no saving here. Shares are conditional E1 estimates.

Audiologist produces patient-specific needs and constraints in s1. Existing catalogue maintainers supply device identifier, specification version, functions and compatibility; missing fields require manual source reading within s2. No free clinical eligibility code is presumed.

Test native filtering before code; no patient data leave the clinical environment. Saving applies only to actual retrieval, not existing catalogue runtime or clinical reasoning. The ordinary completed-note check supplies the requested save gate and edits void it.
unknowns: Local device availability and assessment scope
research_questions: Do native filters shorten specification retrieval without excluding relevant options or implying clinical suitability?

already_counted.description: Actual assessment, residual source lookup, recommendation, note and save remain counted.

incremental.description: Check catalogue field and source-version mappings.

approvals.approved_version: Exact actual recommendation note checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 12 x 35% retrieval reduction = 4.2 gross points less 0.7 upkeep; already filtered catalogues yield zero benefit. All clinical and save time retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Clarify the actual educator or medical staff question about hearing or balance, relevant context and authorised information-sharing scope.
outputs: Actual advice question and sharing scope

steps.what: Find and read current approved hearing or balance source guidance in {DOCS} for the actual professional question.
Advise educators or other medical staff on hearing or balance topics, explaining context, limits and practical implications and answering their questions.
Write and check the actual written follow-up advice and source references in {EMAIL}, verifying meaning, authorised detail and intended recipient after the discussion.
Send the exact checked written hearing or balance advice to the verified educator or medical staff recipient through {EMAIL}.
inputs: Exact follow-up and recipient checked in s4

tasks.design: Configure topic and source-version views in {DOCS} to support professional advice. The audiologist interprets the evidence, discusses the real question and writes the actual follow-up in {EMAIL}; the checked final version has a separate send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant professional guidance is repeatedly found across folders.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding the educational or clinical context and communicating limits.
tasks.human_edge: Professional judgment and responsible contextual advice.

ambition.what: No expanded advice service is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Clinical scope and advice responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Explain communication accommodations to a care team
reach.learn: Care-setting constraints and professional handoff practice

evidence.claim: Native document filtering can shorten approved-source retrieval while the practitioner retains professional advice.

assumptions: This conditional cycle includes actual verbal advice plus requested written follow-up, not a mandatory report for every casual question. Shares are E1 estimates rather than measured baseline facts.

Audiologist captures context through s1 and produces actual advice in s3 and prose in s4. Existing source owners provide guidance topic, audience and approved version; missing metadata requires manual source reading in s2. No meeting transcript or structured question feed is assumed.

Native search is tested first. Recipient and authorised scope are checked on the completed follow-up; changes void the gate. Sending is a distinct action at full retained time, not a source of saving. External-recipient branch is shown; internal colleague discussion is not an external transaction.
research_questions: Does topic filtering reduce actual guidance lookup while preserving full contextual reading?

already_counted.description: Actual question, residual source reading, discussion, written follow-up and send remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain current guidance tags and source versions.

approvals.approved_version: Exact actual advice, authorised detail and recipient checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 15 x 30% source retrieval reduction = 4.5 gross points less 0.5 upkeep; already indexed sources yield no saving. Advice, prose and send retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Patient care, professional judgment and learning remain human.
reach: Contextual advice to educators and care teams
role.ambitious_version: An audiologist who finds reliable materials faster while retaining actual counselling, recommendation and professional exchange.
